script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(NOW(3), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(l.id AS CHAR) AS id, l.free_token, l.owner_operation_id, l.last_owner_operation_id, l.lock_version
  FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) d
  LEFT JOIN inventory_balance_lock l
    ON l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_CLkey.data.tenant}}'
   AND l.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_CLkey.data.org}}'
   AND l.lock_key = '{{node:code_node_CLkey.data.key}}'
   AND l.is_deleted = 0
